title: The Aral Sea: A Sea That Vanished in a Lifetime
core_question: How did one of the largest inland seas on Earth break into fragments within fifty years, and what did it leave behind?
why_they_click: You can watch an entire sea disappear in satellite imagery, decade by decade, while the port towns sit stranded in desert.
data_source: NASA Earth Observatory satellite imagery; USGS and international basin assessment reports; peer-reviewed Aral Sea desiccation studies
evidence: 'geology documentary' is rising +5500%, the biggest trend in the dataset, and this topic is the most visually self-evident one on the list.
